title: Azure Boards Management Configuration
description: Authoritative schema for repository configuration consumed by the azure-boards-management skill. Configuration must validate against this schema before the skill performs any Azure Boards operation.

$schema.description: Path or URI of the schema used by editor tooling.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the configuration file was written against. Used to detect when migration guidance applies.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organisation URL (e.g. https://dev.azure.com/contoso) or organisation name.

project.description: Azure DevOps project name that work items are created and queried in.

workItemTypes.description: Mapping of the skill's logical work item roles to the process template's actual work item type names.

epic.description: Work item type name used for Epics (e.g. "Epic").

feature.description: Work item type name used for Features (e.g. "Feature").

story.description: Work item type name used for User Stories (e.g. "User Story" or "Product Backlog Item").

task.description: Work item type name used for Tasks (e.g. "Task").

defaultAreaPath.description: Default Area Path applied to new work items when no more specific path is supplied.

defaultIterationPath.description: Default Iteration Path applied to new work items when no more specific path is supplied.
